tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the inner track of the language switcher.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Header and app cards: anything that sits on top of color-bg.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on color-bg, color-surface and color-accent-soft.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Lead text, meta lines, card descriptions and the footer, on color-bg and color-surface.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: header and footer rules, card borders and the dividers between policy sections.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: links, the active language, the brand mark and check icons. Text on color-bg and color-surface.

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of links.

tokens.name: color-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Summary box background and the app icon tile.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on color-accent (active language, brand mark, check icons).

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px solid, on every surface.
